senses.definition: A copy of a single sent out to disc jockeys, having the B-side either blank or duplicating the A-side.
senses.example: On the Brass' next single, the company is considering sending out DJ copies with one song on both sides.

senses.definition: The nut of the tree Baillonella toxisperma.
A large, reddish-brown, edible seed from the Southeast Asian tree djenkol, known for its pungent sulfurous odor.
A toxic, sulfur-containing nonprotein amino acid found in djenkol beans.
The city of Djibouti, the capital of the Republic of Djibouti.
Phodopus sungorus, a dwarf hamster with a typically thick, dark grey dorsal stripe and furry feet.
